definitions.gloss: traditional New Year games; New Year's pastimes
definitions.explanation: Traditional games played during the Japanese New Year holiday period. These include activities like kite flying, spinning tops, playing karuta, and battledore and shuttlecock.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どものころ、{正月遊|しょうがつあそ}びをよくした。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often played traditional New Year games.

examples.japanese: {幼稚園|ようちえん}で{正月遊|しょうがつあそ}びを{体験|たいけん}した。
examples.english: At kindergarten, we experienced traditional New Year games.

examples.japanese: {凧揚|たこあ}げやコマ{回|まわ}しなどの{正月遊|しょうがつあそ}びは、{最近|さいきん}の{子|こ}どもにはあまりなじみがない。
examples.english: Traditional New Year games like kite flying and top spinning are unfamiliar to many children nowadays.

notes:
USAGE:
Representative {正月遊|しょうがつあそ}び include:
- {凧揚|たこあ}げ (kite flying)
- コマ{回|まわ}し (top spinning)
- {羽根|はね}つき (battledore and shuttlecock)
- {福笑|ふくわら}い (face-part placement game)
- かるた (karuta card game)
- すごろく (Japanese board game)

These games are part of traditional Japanese New Year culture, though many are less commonly played today. Schools and community events sometimes organize {正月遊|しょうがつあそ}び activities to pass down these traditions.
